title: 4-Step DDGAN Conditional Gaussian Reverse Chain
intuition: Probes Law 3B (Conditional Fiber Identifiability) on a 4-step Denoising Diffusion GAN learning a correlated 2D Gaussian: grades both final ancestral samples AND conditioned reverse-transition slices at t=1,2,3.
failure_mode: Marginal matching alone hides conditional drift-variance confounding: the generator matches the unconditional average while predicting wrong conditional means or collapsed variance on specific x_t strata.
